description.zh:
开启或关闭成员删除许可。取值：

- Enabled：开启。
- Disabled：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the member deletion feature. Valid values:

*   Enabled: enables the member deletion feature
*   Disabled: disables the member deletion feature

title.zh: 开启或关闭成员删除许可

descriptions.zh: 当开启成员删除许可后，才能删除资源账号类型的成员。
descriptions.en: Members of the resource account type can be deleted only after the member deletion feature is enabled.
